title: News State Churn vs Independent Evidence Audit
hypothesis: Issue lifecycle state should not strengthen merely because collection refreshes when independent evidence does not increase.

result.finding: Lifecycle state churned NEW→WEAKENING→STRENGTHENING while current cluster exposes only one independent source and 75% reprints. This is evidence of state-instability risk, not evidence that the market impact strengthened.

contamination: published/observed/actionable clocks not sufficient for causal event study

small_works.note: Prior 82-article mixed cluster is no longer the current top issue; current top issue is smaller but still shows reprint/independence sensitivity.
18 snapshots now exist, but all belong to the same 2026-09-30 KRX session; post-close global moves must not be counted as additional KRX samples.

handoffs.request: Persist lifecycle transition inputs and independent-source delta per transition; prevent collection refresh alone from acting as new evidence.
Audit GN-25b0e75405c01734 chronology/semantic membership and whether STRENGTHENING has evidence beyond one independent source.

Design challenger lifecycle score using independent-source delta, semantic purity and actionable-time alignment; compare against raw article/state escalation only after multi-issue OOS history exists.

next_validation: Accumulate multiple independent issues and KRX sessions
Measure state-transition precision against subsequent independent-source additions
Run chronological OOS comparison only after adequate PIT history
limitations: No causal event-study window with independent pre/post samples
No validated probability can be produced from one independent source/session
